description: Get raw per-student, per-alignment outcome results for a course (one score per assessed alignment, not aggregated), optionally filtered by user_ids, outcome_ids, and include_hidden. Set include_alignments to nest the matching alignments under linked.alignments. When CANVAS_PSEUDONYMIZE_STUDENTS is enabled, linked.users entries are anonymized; use resolve_pseudonym to map one back to a real user. Use get_outcome_rollups instead for aggregated scores per student and outcome, or get_outcome_contributing_scores for the assignment or quiz scores behind one outcome.

include_alignments.description: Include linked alignment details in the response.

include_hidden.description: Include hidden outcomes when Canvas supports it.

outcome_ids.description: Optional outcome IDs to restrict the results.

user_ids.description: Optional Canvas user IDs (pass large IDs as strings) or SIS user IDs prefixed with "sis_user_id:".

name: get_outcome_results
title: Get Outcome Results
